name: expanding-search
title: Expanding search
description: A header search icon that grows into a field in place, with suggestions, Escape to fold back and a full-bar cover on phones.
docs: Put it in the end of a header; the header should be position: relative, because on a phone the field covers it. Control the text with value and onValueChange (or defaultValue), handle Enter with onSubmit, and pass suggestions (strings or { value, hint }) that you have filtered yourself: they appear under the field while it has focus, with arrow keys, Enter and the typed part in bold, and a click on a row calls onSubmit with it. expandedWidth sets how wide the field grows on a screen wider than a phone (a number of px or a CSS length), align="start" grows it towards the end instead. listOpen shows the suggestions whatever has focus, for a preview or your own logic. shortcut opens it from anywhere outside other fields: "/" or "mod+k". Escape and the close button fold it back and return focus to the icon; leaving an empty field folds it too, and one with text stays open so a query is never thrown away. A folded field keeps its text and shows a dot on the icon. The button is named Search and reports aria-expanded. Pass open, defaultOpen and onOpenChange to control it, and autoFocus to focus a field that mounts open.
